# Rogue — Combat

## Talent Prototype

Two normal talent tiers plus one capstone. Canonical Classic identities/icons come from the Combat tree. Unlocks use only the structured tier thresholds; there are no per-node prerequisite chains.

tier_1.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.

tier_2.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.

capstones.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.

talent_model.tier_semantics: Talent tiers are prototype talent progression only and are unrelated to item/building T1–T5 progression.
